parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

> You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain the check item ID.

parameters.name: CheckIds
parameters.description: The list of check item IDs.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs of the affected assets under the check item.

parameters.name: TaskSource
parameters.description:
The task source. Valid values:

- **YAO_CHI**: ApsaraDB console.
